extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
The best time for your community's first Magic game is now. Dive into Foundations, and experience quintessential Magic: The Gathering by playing with and collecting cards selected to give every player the advantage. Whether a past, present, or future Magic player, Foundations invite you to share your spark!
Gain an instant collection! This truly astounding box boasts over 350 cards with essential staples for any color and any way your players want to play. Enjoy old and new favorites alike as you build your first or fiftieth deck with included tutorials and expert recommendations.
Contents:
• 6 Foundations Starter Collections
